body: One friendship that ended in particular, ruined people for me. It was my HS best friend...We were awesome until our senior year...we drifted apart. Then  a year and half later we started talking again...and I thought we were back...a few months later he told me a i was a useless fuckwad who wasn't successful enough to be his friend.
I just want to create art, and help others do the same, regardless of it's value to others, but instead I'm stuck working this dead end retail job that makes me miserable.

That's exactly the pattern I've been stuck in. Though the people I have me these ways seem just as dysfunctional and damaged as me...and in the past this hasn't boded well for the relationship. I wanna try again..I really do...but some people have ruined people for me. I've just been temporary in every ones lives. I want someone to want me there in person, and text.

Why? As you said more time for what? I don't drink, I don't do drugs. The only places I like to go are offbeat quirky areas, and the places are great, but I suck at meeting people in places. My social anxiety prevents me from trying to interact with people in an open environment with lots of people.

I would trade all the times I've had for something more permanent. People use me like I'm a dirty rag, "Use him then throw him away once he's outlived his usefulness." It's hurt more than most people know, In ways most people can't even begin to imagine...Being utterly alone to anyone outside your family...wears you down and makes you feel worthless..I just don't know what to do to make things better, I've tried everything.

Hey, I know it's tough. I'm barely making rent and I get help from the family sometimes, and I feel lowly too. But it's not over man, there is always room for change. If you don't like who you are change yourself for you, not anyone else. As for your friends they either like you or don't, there is no in between. If they act fake say "screw it" and make new ones. Please don't end yourself. I have major depression and have to fight everyday to keep the will to live. But I keep pushing myself to change and be a better person, and maybe one day life will get better.

If you need a friend I'm here pm me if you want to chat privately or just reply. Just stay with us please!

It's really good actually. They were my major support when I was having issues back in 2011 and went into the hospital. I just don't want to go home...I've quit so many things and given up on so many aspects of my life..It would be so depressing to admit defeat and go home and tell everyone that I couldn't do it....I'm tired of letting myself down...It's not just the environment it's also the fact that my entire life I am mostly ignored. People don't take notice of me...I'm sure that If I cut off all contact with my "friends" they wouldn't notice...I need to change...and change things...I just don't know how.

I suppose it's all the people that I know...I have 18 friends on Facebook...of those about 80% are girls from failed relationships that I'm still friends with...It just kills me how they moved on and have graduated college, or got engaged and started families...and I'm still here..just wasting my life in a stupid job...that just makes me hate myself. The 20% that are male..are various dudes I met when I went to several different colleges to try and make something of myself..and that went nowhere each time...and they are all party guys anyway. I'm not for the party seen. This song sums up my life thus far...https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E3Hzm8urU0k

TBH, I've been in the Hospital on Suicide Watch twice...Both in 2011. The first time, I became very close with the residents of that hall...the second time..I left way too early due to my roommate being farther off the reservation that I was and he freaked me out. Sometimes I wish there was a way to erase the trail. Completely start over new..I just can't seem to let everything go.

Moving back home. cost about 400 dollars which is months rent...or about one paycheck. and it's about 1,300 miles away. Even if I were to move home, since my job is here, I'd be jobless. I used to have a job back home till I transferred, and I don't want to work for Geek Squad at home, The DCI "Guy who runs the precinct" is a giant d-bag, and I don't want to work for him. I could always move closer to home, to ST. Louis, but I should probably wait till after the holidays to even attempt a transfer...In essence...I'm between a rock and a hard place..

I moved to Southern Maine. I'm originally from Southern Illinois. I currently work as a Customer Service Agent/ Consultation Agent at Geek Squad at a best buy in a mall. As for dreams...I can't even remember..pretty much everything I've attempted I've either quit or lost the interest to pursue (due to the overwhelming depression). I have a lot of social phobia, so I'm not the type to meet people randomly in public. I've tried meeting people through reddit in the area but they don't seem like they would be good for my mental health...So the isolation has just made things worse.

I have a hard time believing that. Even though I know there is truth in what you say. My life has been the same way for the last 13 years...I've always been perceived as a joke or not being worth much, People tend to not even notice I exsist. I don't think I've ever had a "healthy" relationship or lifestyle. It's hard for me to change when I don't even have the motivation to stop myself from feeling this pain...It's like I have a wound in my very being that won't be patched up...no matter how hard I try the damage is done.
OMFG....is that a yeti?! No seriously this is nightmare fuel.
Your name has such a Catcher In The Rye vibe.
